decisions.reason: As a clearly positioned product line tightly linked to the firm's core geospatial integration capabilities, it is likely meeting current aspiration levels and remains worth retaining.

The building data digital twin service matches the firm's strategic direction, but because market acceptance is still more uncertain than for core offers, it stays on the market under relatively close review.

After the withdrawal of the overlapping identity product, this service stands as the clearer complementary identity offering for GeoIT customers and is likely to be retained unless results fall materially below aspirations.
The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's established consulting and training strengths, so its strategic fit and low commitment make continued retention likely.
